description.zh: 组件自定义参数，使用JSON字符串编码。
description.en: The custom parameters of the component, encoded as a JSON string.

description.zh: 待升级的目标版本。您可以调用`DescribeAddon`接口查看组件可升级的版本。
description.en: The target version to which you want to upgrade. You can call the `DescribeAddon` operation to query the versions to which the component can be upgraded.

description.zh:
组件升级策略。可选值：
- overwrite：覆盖升级。
- canary：金丝雀升级。
description.en:
The component upgrade policy. Valid values:
- overwrite: overwrites the existing version.
- canary: performs a canary upgrade.

descriptions.zh:
- 升级集群组件实例版本可能会影响业务，请评估影响后在业务低峰期操作并提前做好相关的数据备份。
- 升级组件前，请参考[组件发布记录](~~176087~~)了解指定组件的变更内容和变更影响。
- 请依次逐个组件升级，确认一个组件升级成功后再升级下一个组件。
descriptions.en:
- Upgrading cluster component instance versions may affect your services. Assess the impact before performing the upgrade during off-peak hours, and back up relevant data in advance.
- Before upgrading a component, refer to [Component release notes](~~176087~~) to learn about the changes and their impact for the specified component.
- Upgrade components one at a time. Confirm that one component has been upgraded successfully before upgrading the next one.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs upgrade-cluster-addons --cluster-id cf4299b79b3e34226abfdc80a4bda0000 --biz-body component_name=coredns version=v1.11.3.2-f57ea7ed6-aliyun config=CpuRequest_:_800m next_version=v1.11.3.5-5321daf49-aliyun policy=canary --region cn-hangzhou
